t: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones
n: Star Wars": Episode II Attack of the Clones
x: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones is a 2002 film directed by George Lucas & written by Lucas and Jonathan Hales. It is the second part of the Star Wars prequel trilogy.

t: Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope
x: Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope, originally released as Star Wars, is a 1977 space opera film written and directed by George Lucas. It is the first part of the Star Wars original trilogy and the first Star Wars film released.

t: Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith
x: Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith is a 2005 film written and directed by George Lucas. It is the third and final part of the Star Wars prequel trilogy.

t: Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back
x: Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back, originally released as simply The Empire Strikes Back, is a 1980 film directed by Irvin Kershner and written by Leigh Brackett and Lawrence Kasdan from a story by George Lucas. It is the second part of the Star Wars original trilogy.

t: Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi
x: Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi, originally marketed as Revenge of the Jedi and released as simply Return of the Jedi, is a 1983 film directed by Richard Marquand and written by Lawrence Kasdan and George Lucas from a story by Lucas. It is the third and final installment of the Star Wars original trilogy.

t: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords
x: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords is the sequel to Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic, which was widely regarded as a major commercial and critical success. The original game, however, was developed by a different company, BioWare.

t: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace
x: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace is a 1999 film written and directed by George Lucas, produced by Rick McCallum and starring Liam Neeson, Ewan McGregor, Natalie Portman, Jake Lloyd, and Ian McDiarmid.

The Star Wars Holiday Special is a 1978 television special based on a story by George Lucas. The main storyline of the film transpires on the Wookiee home planet of Kashyyyk. Chewbacca and Han Solo visit the planet to celebrate the Wookiee holiday Life Day with his family, which includes his wife Malla, his son Lumpy, and his father Itchy.

Star Wars: Battlefront is a third/first-person shooter video game based around battles featured in the Star Wars movies. It was developed by Pandemic Studios and LucasArts, and released on September 21, 2004 for Xbox (online features returned via Insignia, playable on Xbox 360, Xbox One and Xbox Series X/S), PlayStation 2, and PC (online features returned…

t: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic
x: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (KotOR) is a roleplaying game made originally for the Microsoft Xbox and later released for the PC and Mac OS X, also available on iOS and Android devices.

The Glove of Darth Vader is a Star Wars Legends junior novel written by Paul Davids and Hollace Davids, with interior art by Karl Kesel. It is the first volume of the informally named "Jedi Prince" series, and it was followed by The Lost City of the Jedi.

The Prequel trilogy is the second installment of films of the Star Wars saga to be produced. They were released from 1999 to 2005. The prequel trilogy describes what had taken place 32 years up to 19 years before the events of Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope.
The Original trilogy is the first installment of films of the Star Wars saga to be produced. These were the movies released from 1977 to 1983.

t: The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime
s: Star Wars: The New Jedi Order
x: The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime is a Star Wars Legends novel written by R. A. Salvatore. It is the first volume in the series Star Wars: The New Jedi Order, and it was first published on October 5, 1999 by Del Rey.

Heir to the Empire is a Star Wars Legends novel written by Timothy Zahn. It is the first installment of Star Wars: The Thrawn Trilogy, and it was first published in May 1991 by Bantam Spectra. The novel is set in 9 ABY, five years after Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi, and it introduces the trilogy's eponymous villain, Grand Admiral Thrawn.

Dark Force Rising is a Star Wars Legends novel written by Timothy Zahn. It is the second volume of Star Wars: The Thrawn Trilogy, following Heir to the Empire (1991) and preceding The Last Command (1993). It was first published in hardcover by Bantam Spectra in May 1992, and it was later adapted into a Star Wars: Dark Force Rising comic adaptation.

The Last Command is a Star Wars Legends novel written by Timothy Zahn. It is the sequel to Dark Force Rising (1992) and the final volume of Star Wars: The Thrawn Trilogy. It was first published in hardcover by Bantam Spectra in April 1993, and it was later adapted into a Star Wars: The Last Command comic adaptation.

t: Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy
x: Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy is a Star Wars video game played in first person and third person, and is part of the Jedi Knight series, although it is the first one in which Kyle Katarn is a non-playable character.

Star Wars: Battlefront II is the sequel to Star Wars: Battlefront. It is a high-selling Star Wars video game following the many adventures of several characters. The two games are very similar, as both revolve around troopers from various factions fighting in different locales.

Star Wars: Republic Commando is a first person shooter Star Wars computer and video game, released in the US on February 28, 2005. It was developed and published by LucasArts for the Windows and Xbox platforms, and a port developed and published by Aspyr Media was released for Nintendo Switch and PlayStation 4 on April 6, 2021.

The Truce at Bakura is a Star Wars Legends novel written by Kathy Tyers. It was the fourth novel published by Bantam Spectra, following Star Wars: The Thrawn Trilogy, and it was first printed in hardcover in November 1993. The novel is set in 4 ABY, shortly after the events of Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi.

t: Dark Nest I: The Joiner King
s: Star Wars: The Dark Nest Trilogy
x: Dark Nest I: The Joiner King is a Star Wars Legends novel written by Troy Denning. It is the first volume of Star Wars: The Dark Nest Trilogy, and it was first published on July 26, 2005 by Del Rey. An audiobook version was also produced.

s: Star Wars: Legacy of the Force
x: Legacy of the Force: Exile is the fourth novel in the Star Wars: Legacy of the Force series. It is a paperback by Aaron Allston, published on February 27, 2007, although the Science Fiction Book Club did publish an exclusive hardcover.

t: Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II
x: Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II is a first-person shooter computer game released on October 9, 1997, by LucasArts. This was the first game in the series to include multiplayer capabilities over the Internet or over a LAN.

Star Wars: Dark Forces is a first-person shooter computer game released on February 15, 1995, by LucasArts. The game introduces the character of Kyle Katarn, a former Imperial stormtrooper and agent, now a mercenary for hire in the service of the Rebel Alliance, and uses the 3D Jedi Engine.

t: Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast
x: Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast (aka JK2, JKO, or JO) is a Star Wars computer game released in 2002. It was developed by Raven Software and published, distributed and marketed by LucasArts in North America and by Activision in the rest of the world.

X-Wing: The Bacta War is the fourth installment in the X-Wing series of novels, released in February 1997 by Bantam Spectra. It is a science fiction novel written by Michael A. Stackpole. Anthony Heald narrated the audio version.

t: Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)
x: Star Wars: The Clone Wars is a video game for the Nintendo GameCube, Xbox, and PlayStation 2. It takes place near the end of and shortly after Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones, beginning with the First Battle of Geonosis.

Outbound Flight is a Star Wars Legends novel from author Timothy Zahn that tells the story of the ill-fated Outbound Flight Project, which was originally mentioned in Zahn's 1991 novel, Heir to the Empire. Outbound Flight was first published by Del Rey in hardcover on January 31, 2006.

t: Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith
x: Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith is the expansion pack for the first-person shooter Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II. It was released on February 17, 1998. One of the most attractive attributes of the game for fans was the opportunity to play as Mara Jade, one of the most popular Star Wars Expanded Universe characters.

Shatterpoint is a novel written by Matthew Stover. The first novel in the Clone Wars novel series and the first released in the Clone Wars multimedia project, it was originally published as a hardcover by Del Rey in June 2003.

Tales of the Bounty Hunters is a 1996 short story collection edited by Kevin J. Anderson featuring five short stories about the bounty hunters hunting Han Solo in The Empire Strikes Back. It is the third installment in the Tales series about minor characters from the original trilogy.

Tales from Jabba's Palace is a Star Wars Legends anthology book edited by Kevin J. Anderson that features twenty short stories set in and around Jabba's Palace. It is the second volume of the Tales series, and it was first published by Bantam Spectra in December 1995.

Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter is a Star Wars Legends novel that features the Sith Lord Darth Maul and serves as a precursor to the film Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace. It was written by Michael Reaves and first published by Del Rey in hardcover on January 30, 2001.
MedStar II: Jedi Healer is the second novel of the MedStar Duology, written by Michael Reaves and Steve Perry and published by Del Rey on September 28, 2004.

t: Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure
x: Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure (originally released as The Ewok Adventure) is a 1984 television film directed by John Korty, from a script by Bob Carrau and story by George Lucas. It tells the story of a family of humans who have crash-landed their star cruiser on the forest moon of Endor and their interactions with the native Ewoks.

Ewoks: The Battle for Endor is a 1985 television film written and directed by brothers Jim and Ken Wheat from a story by George Lucas. It focuses on Cindel, a little girl who joins her friends Noa, Wicket and the other Ewoks in facing off against a band of Marauders. The film is a follow-up to 1984's Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure.

t: The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide I: Onslaught
s: Star Wars: The New Jedi Order
x: The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide I: Onslaught is a Star Wars Legends novel written by Michael A. Stackpole. It is the second volume of the Star Wars: The New Jedi Order series and the first installment of the Dark Tide duology. The novel was first published by Del Rey in February 2000, and an audiobook version was also produced.

t: The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin
s: Star Wars: The New Jedi Order
x: The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin is a Star Wars Legends novel written by Michael A. Stackpole. It is the third volume of the Star Wars: The New Jedi Order series, following Dark Tide I: Onslaught and preceding Agents of Chaos I: Hero's Trial. It was first published in paperback by Del Rey on June 6, 2000.

t: The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos I: Hero's Trial
s: Star Wars: The New Jedi Order
x: The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos I: Hero's Trial is a Star Wars Legends novel written by James Luceno. It is the fourth volume of the Star Wars: The New Jedi Order series, following Dark Tide II: Ruin and preceding Agents of Chaos II: Jedi Eclipse. It was first published in paperback by Del Rey in August 2000.

t: The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos II: Jedi Eclipse
s: Star Wars: The New Jedi Order
x: The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos II: Jedi Eclipse is a Star Wars Legends novel written by James Luceno. It is the fifth volume of the Star Wars: The New Jedi Order series, following Agents of Chaos I: Hero's Trial and preceding Balance Point. It was first published in paperback by Del Rey on October 3, 2000.

t: The New Jedi Order: Balance Point
s: Star Wars: The New Jedi Order
x: The New Jedi Order: Balance Point was the sixth novel in the New Jedi Order series. It was written by Kathy Tyers and was published by Del Rey on October 31, 2000. Narration for the audio version was performed by Michael Cumpsty.

t: The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory I: Conquest
s: Star Wars: The New Jedi Order
x: The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory I: Conquest is a Star Wars Legends novel written by Greg Keyes. It is the seventh volume of the Star Wars: The New Jedi Order series, following The New Jedi Order: Balance Point (2000) and preceding The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth (2001). It was first published in paperback by Del Rey on April 3, 2001.

t: The New Jedi Order: Star by Star
s: Star Wars: The New Jedi Order
x: The New Jedi Order: Star by Star is a Star Wars Legends novel written by Troy Denning. It is the ninth volume in the series Star Wars: The New Jedi Order, and it was first published on October 30, 2001 by Del Rey.

t: The New Jedi Order: Dark Journey
s: Star Wars: The New Jedi Order
x: The New Jedi Order: Dark Journey, the tenth book in the New Jedi Order series, is a novel by Elaine Cunningham, published on January 29, 2002 in paperback by Del Rey. It contained an excerpt of The Approaching Storm. The Science Fiction Book Club also published an exclusive hardcover edition.

s: Star Wars: The Han Solo Trilogy
x: The Paradise Snare is a Star Wars Legends novel written by A. C. Crispin. It is the first volume of Star Wars: The Han Solo Trilogy, and it was first published by Bantam Spectra on May 5, 1997. A sequel, The Hutt Gambit, was published later that year. The complete trilogy was reprinted in The Han Solo Trilogy (1998).

s: Star Wars: The Han Solo Trilogy
x: The Hutt Gambit is a Star Wars Legends novel written by A. C. Crispin. It is the second volume of Star Wars: The Han Solo Trilogy, following The Paradise Snare and preceding Rebel Dawn. It was first published by Bantam Spectra on August 11, 1997, and the complete trilogy was reprinted in The Han Solo Trilogy (1998).

s: Star Wars: The Han Solo Trilogy
x: Rebel Dawn is the third book in Star Wars: The Han Solo Trilogy by A. C. Crispin, and the final chapter in the Rise of the Empire era.

t: The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines I: Rebel Dream
s: *Star Wars: The New Jedi Order **Enemy Lines duology
x: The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines I: Rebel Dream, part of the New Jedi Order series and first book of the Enemy Lines duology, is a novel by Aaron Allston, published on March 26, 2002. An excerpt was included in the paperback version of Cloak of Deception. An audiobook version was released February 20, 2007.

t: The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand
s: *Star Wars: The New Jedi Order **Enemy Lines duology
x: The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand, part of the New Jedi Order series and second book of the Enemy Lines duology, is a novel by Aaron Allston, published on May 28, 2002.

s: Star Wars: The New Jedi Order
x: The New Jedi Order: Traitor is a Star Wars Legends novel and the thirteenth volume in the Star Wars: The New Jedi Order series. It was written by Matthew Stover and published by Del Rey in paperback on July 30, 2002. The Science Fiction Book Club released an exclusive hardcover edition that same year.

t: The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way
s: Star Wars: The New Jedi Order
x: The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way is a Star Wars Legends novel and the fourteenth volume in the Star Wars: The New Jedi Order series. It was written by Walter Jon Williams and first published by Del Rey in hardcover on October 1, 2002. The first paperback edition was released on July 29, 2003.

t: The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant
s: Star Wars: The New Jedi Order
x: The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant is a Star Wars Legends novel written by Sean Williams and Shane Dix. It is the fifteenth volume of the Star Wars: The New Jedi Order series, and it was first published in paperback by Del Rey on February 4, 2003. A sequel, The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic II: Refugee, was published later that year.

t: The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic II: Refugee
s: *Star Wars: The New Jedi Order **Force Heretic trilogy
x: The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic II: Refugee, the second book in the Force Heretic trilogy, is a novel by Sean Williams and Shane Dix, published in 2003. It includes a preview of Shatterpoint.

t: The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic III: Reunion
s: *Star Wars: The New Jedi Order **Force Heretic trilogy
x: The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic III: Reunion is the third novel in the Force Heretic trilogy written by Sean Williams and Shane Dix. It was published by Del Rey in July 2003.

t: The New Jedi Order: The Final Prophecy
s: Star Wars: The New Jedi Order
x: The New Jedi Order: The Final Prophecy is a Star Wars Legends novel and the eighteenth and penultimate volume in the Star Wars: The New Jedi Order series. It was written by Greg Keyes and published by Del Rey in paperback on September 30, 2003. The Science Fiction Book Club released an exclusive hardcover edition that same year.

t: The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force
s: Star Wars: The New Jedi Order
x: The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force is a Star Wars Legends novel written by James Luceno. It is the nineteenth and final volume in the series Star Wars: The New Jedi Order, and it was first published on November 4, 2003 by Del Rey.

Darth Maul: Saboteur is a short story written by James Luceno, set in 33 BBY. In February 2001 it was made available online in eBook format by Del Rey. It is available for immediate download from Amazon.com for US$1.99 and is approximately 14,000 words in length.

Cloak of Deception is a novel by James Luceno that takes place less than a year before Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace. Narration for the audio version was performed by Alexander Adams. The paperback version included a 15-page excerpt of The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines I: Rebel Dream.

Rogue Planet is a Legends novel written by Greg Bear. It is set in 29 BBY, and follows Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi on a mission to Zonama Sekot. The novel was first published on May 2, 2000 by Del Rey.

The Approaching Storm is the Star Wars Legends prologue novel to the prequel trilogy film Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones. It was written by Alan Dean Foster and first published by Del Rey in hardcover on January 29, 2002. The first paperback edition was released in January 2003.

t: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)
n: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones
x: The Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones novelization by R. A. Salvatore, published by Del Rey on April 23, 2002, is the official novel adaptation of the film Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones. It includes expansion of scenes from the movie, many scenes cut from the movie, and several original scenes.

Republic Commando: Hard Contact is a 293-page tie-in novel to the video game Star Wars: Republic Commando and the first novel in the Republic Commando series. The book, written by Karen Traviss and published by Del Rey on October 26, 2004, is set in 22 BBY during the Rise of the Empire era.

The Cestus Deception is a novel by Steven Barnes that was first published by Del Rey in hardcover on June 1 2004. The first paperback edition was released in March 2005. The book is part of the Clone Wars multimedia project. The novella The Hive, also written by Barnes, serves as a tie-in to the novel. The HoloNet News story from HoloNet News Vol.

MedStar I: Battle Surgeons is the first of two novels in the MedStar Duology, and written by Michael Reaves and Steve Perry and published by Del Rey on June 29, 2004. It takes place in 20 BBY, 2 years after the Battle of Geonosis. The book is part of the Clone Wars multimedia project.

Jedi Trial is a novel written by David Sherman and Dan Cragg. It was published by Del Rey on October 26, 2004 in hardback. The first paperback edition was released on May 31, 2005. Jedi Trial is the story of Anakin Skywalker and Nejaa Halcyon and their fight to free a crucial communications hub from the Separatists.

Yoda: Dark Rendezvous is a Star Wars Legends novel written by Sean Stewart. It is a part of the Clone Wars multimedia project, and it was first published by Del Rey on November 23, 2004, along with an abridged version. An unabridged version of the audiobook was released on January 23, 2024 as part of The Essential Legends Collection.

Labyrinth of Evil is a Star Wars Legends novel written by James Luceno. It serves as a direct prequel to the film Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith, and it was first published on January 25, 2005 by Del Rey.

t: Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon
s: Star Wars: The Lando Calrissian Adventures
x: Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon is a Star Wars Legends novel written by L. Neil Smith. It is the second volume of the Star Wars: The Lando Calrissian Adventures series, following The Mindharp of Sharu and preceding The Starcave of ThonBoka.

t: Lando Calrissian and the Starcave of ThonBoka
s: Star Wars: The Lando Calrissian Adventures
x: Lando Calrissian and the Starcave of ThonBoka is a Star Wars Legends novel written by L. Neil Smith. It is a sequel to Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon, and it is the third and final volume of the Star Wars: The Lando Calrissian Adventures series. It was first published in paperback by Del Rey on November 12, 1983.

s: Star Wars: The Han Solo Adventures
x: Han Solo at Stars' End, formerly subtitled From the Adventures of Luke Skywalker, is a Star Wars Legends novel written by Brian Daley. It is the first volume in the Star Wars: The Han Solo Adventures series, and it was first published by Del Rey in April 1979. A sequel, Han Solo's Revenge, was published later that year.

s: Star Wars: The Han Solo Adventures
x: Han Solo's Revenge is a Star Wars Legends novel written by Brian Daley. It is the second volume of the Star Wars: The Han Solo Adventures trilogy, and it was first published by Del Rey on October 12, 1979. A sequel, Han Solo and the Lost Legacy, was published in 1980, and the complete trilogy was reprinted in The Han Solo Adventures (1992).

t: Han Solo and the Lost Legacy
s: Star Wars: The Han Solo Adventures
x: Han Solo and the Lost Legacy is a Star Wars Legends novel written by Brian Daley. It is the third and final volume of the Star Wars: The Han Solo Adventures series, and it was first published by Del Rey in August 1980. The complete trilogy was reprinted in The Han Solo Adventures (1992).

t: Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu
s: Star Wars: The Lando Calrissian Adventures
x: Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu is a Star Wars Legends novel written by L. Neil Smith. It is the first volume of the Star Wars: The Lando Calrissian Adventures series, and it was first published in paperback by Del Rey on June 12, 1983. The complete series was compiled in The Lando Calrissian Adventures (1994).

t: Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina
x: Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina is a Star Wars Legends anthology book featuring sixteen short stories set in and around Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina. It was edited by Kevin J. Anderson, and it was first published in July 1995 by Bantam Spectra.

t: Star Wars Galaxies: The Ruins of Dantooine
s: Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided
x: Star Wars Galaxies: The Ruins of Dantooine is a Legends novel written by Voronica Whitney-Robinson, with W. Haden Blackman. It is based on the video game Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided, and it was first published by Del Rey on December 30, 2003. A prequel short story titled "Pearls in the Sand" was written by Whitney-Robinson and published in 2004.

Splinter of the Mind's Eye, formerly subtitled From the Further Adventures of Luke Skywalker, is a Star Wars Legends novel written by Alan Dean Foster. It acts as a sequel to Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope, which Foster wrote the novelization of, and it was the first installment of the Star Wars Expanded Universe.
The Mandalorian Armor is the first novel in The Bounty Hunter Wars trilogy, written by K. W. Jeter and published in June 1998 by Bantam Spectra.
Slave Ship is the second novel in The Bounty Hunter Wars trilogy. It was written by K. W. Jeter and published in October 1998 by Bantam Spectra.
Hard Merchandise is the third and final novel in The Bounty Hunter Wars trilogy, written by K. W. Jeter and published in July 1999 by Bantam Spectra.
Star Wars: Demolition is a vehicular combat game featuring locations and vehicles from around the Star Wars galaxy.

Star Wars: Empire at War (sometimes abbreviated EaW) is a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Real-time_tactics Real-time tactics] (RTT) and [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Real-time_strategy Real-time strategy] (RTS) video game developed by Petroglyph and published by LucasArts, that takes place in the Star Wars universe.

s: Star Wars: Legacy of the Force
x: Legacy of the Force: Betrayal is a Star Wars Legends novel and the first volume in the Star Wars: Legacy of the Force series. It was written by Aaron Allston and first published by Del Rey in hardcover on May 30, 2006.

t: Dark Nest II: The Unseen Queen
s: Star Wars: The Dark Nest Trilogy
x: Dark Nest II: The Unseen Queen is the second novel of Star Wars: The Dark Nest Trilogy by Troy Denning. It was published by Del Rey on September 27, 2005. Narration for the audio version was performed by Jonathan Davis.

t: Dark Nest III: The Swarm War
s: Star Wars: The Dark Nest Trilogy
x: Dark Nest III: The Swarm War is the third novel of Star Wars: The Dark Nest Trilogy by Troy Denning. It was released from Del Rey Books on December 27, 2005. Narration for the audio version was performed by Jonathan Davis.

Shield of Lies is a Star Wars Legends novel that was written by Michael P. Kube-McDowell. It is the second novel of The Black Fleet Crisis trilogy, and it was published by Bantam Spectra in September, 1996. It was followed by Tyrant's Test later that year.

Tyrant's Test is a Star Wars Legends novel written by Michael P. Kube-McDowell. It is the third and final installment of the Black Fleet Crisis trilogy, and it was first published in December 1996 by Bantam Spectra.

Before the Storm is a Star Wars Legends novel written by Michael P. Kube-McDowell. It is the first book in the Black Fleet Crisis trilogy, and it was first published in March 1996. A sequel, Shield of Lies, was published later that year.

Star Wars: Bounty Hunter is a third-person action-adventure video game that preludes Episode II Attack of the Clones and tells the story of how and why Jango Fett became the template for the clones of the Grand Army of the Republic. It was developed by LucasArts and released in 2002 for the PlayStation 2 and Nintendo GameCube.
Empire 13 is the thirteenth issue in the Star Wars: Empire series of comics. It was published on November 26, 2003 by Dark Horse Comics.
Empire 14 is the fourteenth issue in the Star Wars: Empire series of comics. It was published on December 10, 2003 by Dark Horse Comics.
Empire 19 is the nineteenth issue in the Star Wars: Empire series of comics. It was published on May 12, 2004 by Dark Horse Comics.
Star Wars Galaxies, often abbreviated SWG, was a Star Wars–themed MMORPG developed by Sony Online Entertainment (SOE) and published by LucasArts for Microsoft Windows PCs.

s: Star Wars: Rogue Squadron video game series
x: Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (Star Wars: Rogue Squadron 3D for PC) is a video game that was first released for the Nintendo 64 video game console and the PC on December 7, 1998. It was one of the first Nintendo 64 games to support the console's Expansion Pak, which allowed higher-quality graphics to be displayed while playing.

Super Star Wars is the first of a series of three Super Nintendo games based on the original three films of the Star Wars series, released November 30, 1992. The plot is based on . In 2009 the game was released on the Wii's Virtual Console and on November 17, 2015, it was ported to PlayStation 4 and Vita.

t: Super Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back
x: Super Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back, sometimes called Super The Empire Strikes Back or simply Super Empire Strikes Back is a platform game for the Super Nintendo (Super Famicom in Japan) which follows Super Star Wars and precedes Super Star Wars: Return of the Jedi.

t: Super Star Wars: Return of the Jedi
x: Super Star Wars: Return of the Jedi, sometimes called Super Return of the Jedi, is a platform game for the Super Nintendo Entertainment System (Super Famicom in Japan) and Nintendo Game Boy which follows Super Star Wars and Super Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back. There is also a simplified version for the Sega Game Gear portable system.
Star Wars: Force Commander is a real-time strategy (RTS) computer game released for the PC in March 2000.

s: Star Wars: The New Jedi Order
x: The New Jedi Order: Recovery is the first eBook and seventh installment of The New Jedi Order series set in the Star Wars galaxy. This short story by Troy Denning sets the stage for much of the novel The New Jedi Order: Star by Star and shows a slow reconciliation between Han Solo and his wife Leia Organa Solo.

s: Star Wars: The New Jedi Order
x: The New Jedi Order: Ylesia, part of the New Jedi Order series, is an eBook novella by Walter Jon Williams, published in 2002 and set at the same time as Williams's novel The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way, in between chapter 21 and chapter 22 of the book.

s: Star Wars: The New Jedi Order
x: "The Apprentice" is a short story written by Elaine Cunningham and is the thirteenth installment of the New Jedi Order series set in the Star Wars universe. Set during the events of Dark Journey, this short story expands upon details briefly mentioned in The New Jedi Order: Dark Journey.

Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds is a 2001 real-time strategy video game developed by Ensemble Studios and published by LucasArts. Galactic Battlegrounds utilizes the Genie engine, known for its use in the Age of Empires series, also developed by Ensemble, from which the game borrows many elements.
Star Wars: Rebellion (or Star Wars: Supremacy in the United Kingdom) was a LucasArts strategy game released on February 28, 1998.

t: Star Wars: Rebel Assault II: The Hidden Empire
x: Star Wars: Rebel Assault II: The Hidden Empire is a 1995 video game. It is the sequel to Star Wars: Rebel Assault.

Star Wars: Rebel Assault is the first CD-ROM-only game published by LucasArts, set in the Star Wars universe during the early Galactic Civil War. The game was followed by Star Wars: Rebel Assault II: The Hidden Empire.

s: Star Wars: The Hand of Thrawn Duology
x: Specter of the Past is the first book in Star Wars: The Hand of Thrawn Duology by Timothy Zahn. It was first published by Bantam Spectra in November 1997. Narration for the abridged audio version was performed by Anthony Heald. Narration for the unabridged audio version was performed by Marc Thompson.

s: Star Wars: The Hand of Thrawn Duology

Star Wars 1 is the first issue of the Legends comic book series Star Wars. Star Wars Annual 3 is the third special issue of the Marvel comic book series Star Wars. Written by Jason Latour, with art by Michael Walsh, it was published on September 20, 2017.
The Star Wars rough draft was written as a full rough draft by George Lucas in May 1974. The script was begun in the winter of 1973 as an expansion of the original The Star Wars story synopsis.
"The Occupation of Rhamalai" is a 35-page short story written by M. H. Watkins that was originally published in Star Wars Adventure Journal 13 by West End Games in May 1997.

The Star Wars first draft was the first revision to the rough draft, written by George Lucas in July of 1974. Most of the revision centered on names, and many of these changes were later rejected when George Lucas wrote the second draft, entitled Adventures of the Starkiller, Episode I: The Star Wars, in early 1975.
"A Favor Done..." is a short story, originally published in Secrets of the Sisar Run. It was later archived on Hyperspace.
"A Grand Admiral Returns" is a short story written by Bill Slavicsek, originally published in the Heir to the Empire Sourcebook and later archived on Hyperspace. The story is set 8 ABY.
"The Hearing" is a short dialogue written by Michael Allen Horne, originally published in the Dark Empire Sourcebook and later archived on Hyperspace.
"Droids Can't Fly" is a short story written by Peter Schweighofer, originally published in the Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook and later archived on Hyperspace.

"Cantina Communications" is a short story written by John Chesterman, originally published in Star Wars Official Poster Monthly 16, The Star Wars Compendium 2: The World of Star Wars, and later archived on Hyperspace.
"Camie's Story" is a short story written by Grant S. Boucher, originally published in Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope and The Movie Trilogy Sourcebook. It was later archived on Hyperspace.
"Admiral Jerjerrod's Testimony" is a short dialogue written by Greg Gorden, originally published in the Imperial Sourcebook and later archived on Hyperspace.

"Night Attack" is a short story written by Michael Stern for the 1990 Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game sourcebook Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi from West End Games. The story tells of Major Bren Derlin leading the Rebel strike team's insertion into Endor.

The The Star Wars story synopsis for The Star Wars, also referred to as the first treatment of Star Wars, was the first step in the creation of the script for Episode IV. George Lucas wrote it in the spring of 1973 and gave it to United Artists for perusal on May 7, 1973. It was rejected on May 29, 1973, because of the projected budget of $3 million.

"All the Extras" is a short story written by Peter M. Schweighofer, originally published in the Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook and later archived on Hyperspace.
"A Day at the Races" is a short story written by Bill Slavicsek, originally published in the Dark Force Rising Sourcebook and later archived on Hyperspace.

t: Star Wars Special: The Constancia Affair

Meltdown on Hoth was a children's book written by Jane Mason and illustrated by Chris Trevas. It tells a story set just before The Empire Strikes Back, when C-3PO and R2-D2 deal with a problem of heat in Princess Leia's Echo Base quarters, as mentioned in the opening scenes of the film.

t: Star Wars: X-Wing Tour of Duty: Imperial Pursuit

t: Star Wars: X-Wing Tour of Duty: B-Wing

Jedi Dawn is a "choose your own adventure"–style roleplaying book, written by Paul Cockburn and published, in the United Kingdom only, by Boxtree in 1993. It was the first part of The Lost Jedi adventure game series. The story was later collected along with The Bounty Hunter in The Lost Jedi Adventure Game Book.

The Bounty Hunter is a "choose your own adventure"–style roleplaying book, written by Paul Cockburn and published, in the United Kingdom only, by Boxtree in 1994. It was the second (and last) part of The Lost Jedi adventure game series. The story was later collected along with Jedi Dawn in The Lost Jedi Adventure Game Book.

Anakin's Pit Droid is a children's storybook written by Justine and Ron Fontes and illustrated by Christopher Moroney. It is a Jedi Readers Step 2 (Grades 1-3) young readers publication. It tells the story of Pit Droid DUM-4 and his search for a part needed for Anakin Skywalker's podracer just before the Boonta Eve Classic in Episode I.

"Gottu and His Vibro-ax" is a short story written by Bill Slavicsek, originally published in the Dark Force Rising Sourcebook as "Gottu and His Vibroaxe." It was reprinted with the alternate spelling for vibro-ax in 1996's The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook and later archived on Hyperspace.
"A Necessary Evil" is a short story written by Chuck Truett based on an illustration by Dan Schaefer. It was originally published in Creatures of the Galaxy and later archived on Hyperspace.
Star Wars Manga: Silver is the second volume of Star Wars Manga, a duology of anthology books published by Tokyopop. It follows Star Wars Manga: Black.

"Special Ops: Drop Points" is a short story in Star Wars Adventure Journal 14. It was written by John Beyer and Kathy Burdette and illustrated by Chris Trevas.

The story is the tale of a Kaminoan deity, Protas, as translated by Ryan Kaufman from the Kaminoan language to Basic.

Star Wars Annual No. 1 was a hardcover comic book released in the United Kingdom in 1978 that collected the Star Wars Marvel UK series of comic books of the adaptation of Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope. The story was first published in the UK in the Star Wars Weekly comic series.
Star Wars Annual 1979 was a hardcover comic book released in the United Kingdom that collected two stories originally published as Star Wars (1977) 13 and Star Wars (1977) 14.

Star Wars: Battlefront III was a video game in development at Free Radical Design since 2006, and was to be the third installment in the original Battlefront series. It was eventually cancelled in 2008.
Darth Maul's Revenge is a Random House Jedi Readers Step 3 novel released in November 2000. It was written by Eric Arnold.

"Conversation in Shadow" is an article written by August Hahn and Cynthia Hahn as a tie in to the Living Force campaign. It was published on the Wizards of the Coast website on July 29, 2004 and described a visit by Jedi Master Mace Windu to the Almas Academy.

Queen in Disguise is a children's picture book written by Monica Kulling and illustrated by John Alvin. Star Wars Fan Club Special 2008 was a special comic released by Dark Horse. It included the Star Wars Fan Club membership kit, shipped to everyone who ordered or renewed their Hyperspace membership after November 7, 2007. The first issues were mailed out in March 2008.

Star Wars: The Clone Wars is a 2008 animated feature film directed by Dave Filoni and executive produced by George Lucas as well as the first Star Wars animated film made. The plot focuses on a struggle between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems—each vying for Jabba the Hutt's permission to use Hutt Space's trade routes.

Star Wars: Clone Wars Cine-Manga is a PhotoComic adaptation of the Star Wars: Clone Wars animated television series. It adapted the complete first season of the series alongside episode one of Season Two.

Star Wars: Making Magic is an interactive CD-ROM released in 1996 by LucasArts as part of The LucasArts Archives Vol. II: Star Wars Collection and its Mac edition. It was also included on the CD for Star Wars: Yoda Stories, released in 1997. It was designed as a behind-the-scenes look at the production of Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition release.
Star Wars: Droids was a 1988 platform game produced for the Amstrad CPC, Commodore 64, and the ZX Spectrum. It was loosely tied to the Star Wars: Droids cartoon series.

"Dark Hands" is a short story by August and Cynthia Hahn, released on August 18, 2005, and set within the Living Force setting from Wizards of the Coast. Following the story arc of Jedi Master Darrus Jeht, it describes his sabotage of a Separatist factory building DSD1 dwarf spider droids from the perspective of a fallen Jedi that Jeht was sent to kill.
"Dark Heart" was an online short story published by Wizards of the Coast for the Living Force campaign. It was written by August and Cynthia Hahn and released on June 16, 2005 .

"Precipice" is a short story written by Chris Cassidy, originally exclusive to Hyperspace. On October 1, 2012, it was republished on Suvudu, a subsidiary website of Random House publishing. The story is a retelling of the confrontation between the captive Obi-Wan Kenobi and Dooku in Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones.
